data.name: WOYO!! 2
data.detailed_description:
The second installment of the WOYO!! Saga— a French turn-based JRPG set in the heart of the Parisian suburbs.

Rediscover Montreuil with your team of misfits and take on your terrifying enemies: pigeons, mobsters, barflies, and other shmucks.

Features:

-A new cast of six endearing characters with unique gameplay styles

-A massive soundtrack featuring the best indie artists from Montreuil and beyond

-An enhanced combat system, with multiple ways to approach each fight

-Build your team and adopt the playstyle that suits you

-Explore new neighborhoods in Montreuil and face off against new enemies

-Characters more realistic than ever, thanks to real photos of real people.

-An experience blending escapism and realism: cook, make cocktails, roll joints, hang out on the street, go to work, eat kebabs, grow weed, and much more

-A well-crafted story that’s both gripping and hilarious
